profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Enverus
profile.summary:
I am a Technical Leader with over 20 years of experience designing and delivering large-scale distributed systems across telecommunications, IoT, and data analytics platforms.

Throughout my career I have focused on building high-performance, scalable platforms that power mission-critical services for global service providers. My work spans real-time analytics, large-scale data processing, IoT device management, and modernization of complex legacy systems.

Recently at Synamedia, I architected and delivered a real-time analytics platform processing over 30TB of telemetry data daily to monitor video service QoS and QoE. The system reduced processing time by 95% while eliminating costly licensed analytics solutions.

Previously at Cisco Systems, I led the delivery of a multi-million-dollar zero-touch IoT provisioning platform for a Tier-1 service provider, enabling large-scale onboarding and lifecycle management of connected devices used in home security and rural connectivity services.

I enjoy solving complex technical challenges, mentoring engineers, and translating business goals into scalable technical architectures.

Core areas of expertise include:

• Distributed Systems Architecture
• Real-Time Data Analytics Platforms
• Cloud-Native Systems
• High-Throughput Data Pipelines
• IoT Device Lifecycle Management
• System Modernization & Scalability
• Technical Leadership & Cross-Functional Delivery

Technologies I frequently work with include Python, Java, Kafka, Spark, ClickHouse, Cassandra, Kubernetes, AWS, and large-scale data platforms.
